source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for October 5 to 9
source.evidenceText: Mike Nelson, XBOX Wire Editor October 2, 2026 · 7 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Gears of War: E-Day Pre-Order Xbox Game Studios ☆☆☆☆☆ 2330 ★★★★★ Get it now Gears of War: E-Day – October 6Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Experience the horror and brutality of Emergence Day. Fourteen years before the original Gears of War, join Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago in a gripping origin-story campaign as the Locust Horde first erupt from below, igniting a desperate fight for survival. Rally your squad and fight on in multiplayer with a reimagination of Gears’ iconic PvE mode, Horde Siege, or go head-to-head with a refined Versus PvP. Built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers the most immersive Gears yet. STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ Secret Mode ☆☆☆☆☆ 142 ★★★★★ Get it now STAR WARS: Galactic Racer – October 6 A ​​runs-based​​, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim of the ​​STAR WARS​​ galaxy.​​​​ The Empire’s grip on the galaxy has finally broken, and with its fall comes a new obsession: speed. As the New Republic struggles to rebuild, gambling, entertainment, and glory fuel a booming underground. Out of this chaos, the Galactic League is born: an unsanctioned racing circuit where syndicates sponsor pilots, fortunes are won and lost in seconds, and only the bold survive. No Force. No prophecy. Just skill, strategy, and the will to rise. KINGDOM HEARTS Collection [I～III] SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD. ☆☆☆☆☆ 38 ★★★★★ $74.99 Get it now KINGDOM HEARTS Collection [I～III] – October 6XBOX Play Anywhere A value‑packed bundle featuring three collections: KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-, KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue, and KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC). Echo Weaver Akupara Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 48 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Free Trial Echo Weaver – October 8Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Master an unraveling time loop in this knowledge-based Metroidvania. As the last Weaver, exploit time-altering anomalies and use what you learn to break the cycle. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop. Hidden Dogs Silesia Games Sp. z o.o. ☆☆☆☆☆ 9 ★★★★★ $4.99 $3.99 Get it now Hidden Dogs – October 7 Welcome to puppy village! Labby needs your help with a top-secret mission: creating a video game just for dogs (move over, cats!). Find 500+ hidden dogs and items scattered across 15 cozy, hand-drawn levels in the English countryside. Got stuck? Just blow the dog whistle! Keep finding pups to watch the map grow and come to life with moving planes, boats, and trains! Titanic Escape Simulator MagicProStudio ☆☆☆☆☆ 13 ★★★★★ $24.99 Get it now Titanic Escape Simulator – October 7XBOX Play Anywhere You are a private investigator aboard the world’s most famous ocean liner. What begins as a routine voyage soon becomes something far darker: a suspicious death, hidden clues, locked rooms, restricted decks, and a mystery buried deep within the ship. Explore the Titanic before disaster strikes. Question passengers, search cabins, uncover secrets, and follow a trail that leads from the elegance of First Class to the shadowed lower decks below. But as the truth begins to surface, so does the danger. Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire JanduSoft ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $19.99 $15.99 Get it now Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire – October 7XBOX Play Anywhere An action-farming-roguelite set in Transylvania, the homeland of Dracula and his rebellious lastborn son, Voltaire. An epiphany results in a change of heart for the young vampire: abandoning blood in favor of a plant-based diet out of spite to prove to his father that neck-biting is not the only way for vampires to thrive. Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival Saber Interactive Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ 143 ★★★★★ Get it now Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival – October 8 Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Play the story of Aidan, who must use the power of a mysterious puzzle box – the Genesis Configuration – to help his girlfriend Sunny’s escape from the otherworldly hellscape of the Labyrinth. Wield the powers of the box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead and do battle with the horrific cult devoted to the Cenobites. Neon Abyss 2 Kepler Interactive ☆☆☆☆☆ 140 ★★★★★ $19.99 $15.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Neon Abyss 2 – October 8XBOX Play Anywhere Dive deeper into the chaotic, beautifully pixelated Abyss with Neon Abyss 2! The action is faster, the stakes are higher, and the possibilities are endless in this cybermyth roguelike. With explosive run ‘n’ gun gameplay, diverse combat styles, and unlimited item synergies, Neon Abyss 2 delivers a dramatic, thrill-packed experience every time you enter. Deck of Haunts DANGEN Entertainment ☆☆☆☆☆ 14 ★★★★★ $19.99 $17.99 Get it now Deck of Haunts – October 8 Deck of Haunts invites you to step into the eerie role of a malevolent Haunted House, where the walls whisper secrets and terror lurks around every corner. As the master of this cursed domain, your goal is to ensnare daring humans, play on their fears, and drain their very essence to expand your dark influence. Forever Ago Annapurna Interactive ☆☆☆☆☆ 111 ★★★★★ $19.99 $17.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Forever Ago – October 8XBOX Play Anywhere Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption. In this single-player road trip adventure, you’ll travel to beautiful places, capture memories with your camera, meet interesting characters, and even make some new friends. Gear.Club Unlimited 3 Nacon ☆☆☆☆☆ 3 ★★★★★ Get it now Gear.Club Unlimited 3 – October 8XBOX Play Anywhere For

source.evidenceText: Mike Nelson, XBOX Wire Editor September 25, 2026 · 10 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Minecraft Dungeons II Xbox Game Studios ☆☆☆☆☆ 551 ★★★★★ Get it now Minecraft Dungeons II – September 28Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword, and charge into a thrilling new adventure in Minecraft Dungeons II. Journey through unexplored lands and mysterious locations, in a quest to stop a new evil from causing chaos in not one, but two worlds! Clash with menacing foes in explosive encounters and fight your way through hordes of mobs that will do everything in their power to stop you! Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition Pre-Order Xbox Game Studios ☆☆☆☆☆ 2533 ★★★★★ Get it now Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition – October 1XBOX Play Anywhere Experience the horror and brutality of Emergence Day. Fourteen years before the original Gears of War, join Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago in a gripping origin-story campaign as the Locust Horde first erupt from below, igniting a desperate fight for survival. Rally your squad and fight on in multiplayer with a reimagination of Gears’ iconic PvE mode, Horde Siege, or go head-to-head with a refined Versus PvP. Built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers the most immersive Gears yet. ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE Pre-Order Bandai Namco Entertainment America Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ 269 ★★★★★ Get it now Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve – October 2Step into the cockpit and take flight as an elite pilot across stunning skies. Enter intense dogfights, eliminate threats, and rise through gripping missions to earn your wings in this game developed by PROJECT ACES, the acclaimed team behind the franchise. Early Access starts September 28 for those who pre-order the Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Deluxe Edition. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered CD PROJEKT RED ☆☆☆☆☆ 6637 ★★★★★ $49.99 Get it now Xbox One X Enhanced The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered – September 29XBOX Play Anywhere Free upgrade for all owners of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. Discover the definitive version of the award-winning dark fantasy role-playing game on September 29. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered brings an array of improvements and modernizations to visuals, gameplay, character progression, and much more. Remastered also includes the acclaimed Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine expansions. Gothic II Complete Classic THQ Nordic ☆☆☆☆☆ 17 ★★★★★ $29.99 Get it now Gothic II Complete Classic – September 28 Gothic II Complete Classic brings together the excitement of Gothic II and the expansion Night of the Raven. You have torn down the magical barrier and freed the prisoners of the Valley of Mines. Now the former convicts roam the forests and mountains, causing trouble around the city of Khorinis. Way of the Hunter 2 THQ Nordic ☆☆☆☆☆ 123 ★★★★★ Get it now Way of the Hunter 2 – September 28 Feel the thrill of the hunt and keep an eye out for the wild and wonderous species that are roaming the wilderness. Hunt in North America and display big game like Moose, Elk, Bears, and Bison as well as, smaller animals like Rabbits, Turkeys and various other birds. DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Complete Edition Remastered KOEI TECMO AMERICA ☆☆☆☆☆ 91 ★★★★★ Get it now Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered – October 1 A striking revival of DYNASTY WARRIORS 3 and DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends, which established the foundation of the entire series. The complete cast of more than 40 officers and numerous battlefields beautifully recreated using Unreal Engine 5. Experience even more enjoyable and thrilling action as you aim for the peak of 1 vs. 1,000! End of Abyss Epic Games Publishing ☆☆☆☆☆ 94 ★★★★★ $29.99 Get it now Free Trial End of Abyss – October 1 In the depths of a mysterious underground compound, a mission to investigate disturbances of unknown origin spirals into a harrowing descent through a broken and abandoned world. Play as the young combat technician, Cel, as she uncovers the truth behind the facility’s derelict areas and confronts the monstrous creatures that roam them. Ultimate Admiral: Dreadnoughts Samustai LTD ☆☆☆☆☆ 5 ★★★★★ $34.99 Get it now Ultimate Admiral: Dreadnoughts – October 1XBOX Play Anywhere Ultimate Admiral: Dreadnoughts offers a unique opportunity to design and build countless variations of realistic looking warships combined with an extremely in-depth combat model. Recreate famous ships such as the HMS Dreadnought and countless speculative designs. Experiment and enjoy naval battles utilizing endless combinations of ship designs in technology eras between the years 1890 and 1950 for ten different nations. Keep Driving YCJY Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 12 ★★★★★ $17.99 Get it now Keep Driving – September 28 An atmospheric management RPG about life on the open road. Pick up hitchhikers, work odd jobs, customize and repair your car, and map your route across the country. Use upgrades, skills and items to overcome challenges. And remember to take it easy. You’re young. You have time. Blades & Battles QUByte Interactive ☆☆☆☆☆ 1 ★★★★★ $14.99 $12.74 Get it now Blades & Battles – September 28XBOX Play Anywhere Blades & Battles combines the spirit of ‘90s arcades with the fluidity of modern combat. Explore a fantasy world inspired by Arthurian legends and prove your skill against colossal bosses. Fight solo or invite a friend for local co-op and relive the glory of couch co-op battles.
